Dear Sir,

This is a final reminder regarding the outstanding payment. Details as attached on the SOA.

Despite our previous follow-ups, we have yet to receive the payment.

This continued non-payment is concerning and reflects poorly on the professional terms of our business relationship.

We kindly request that you arrange for immediate settlement of the outstanding amount to avoid any further action or disruption in services.

Please treat this matter with urgency. If the payment has already been processed, kindly share the transaction details at your earliest convenience.

We appreciate your prompt attention to this issue.

With Regards,
